note: Recompiler-only names for static (boot segment) libultra functions. N64Recomp replaces libultra functions BY NAME with N64ModernRuntime implementations (reimplemented list) or drops them (ignored list). Lane w21r found 43 static functions whose inventory name was not their identity; lane w22g renamed them in the inventory (symbol_addrs.us.txt, Conveyor DB, locks, src/rom) to their ultralib VERSION_J names (docs/SYMBOL_MISATTRIBUTION.md, cloud/work/frontier/w22g/renames.json), so the recompiler now sees the right names directly. What remains here are the functions whose recompiler name must differ from the canonical inventory name: a canonical name that is on N64Recomp's lists but must stay emitted (or is shimmed, patches.json) gets suffix _rx, and the three PI raw functions keep their pre-J names (osPiRawStartDma, osEPiRawStartDma) that N64Recomp knows, while VERSION_J (and the inventory) spells them __osPiRawStartDma/__osEPiRawStartDma/__osPiRawReadIo. gen_config.py renames these functions in the recompiler's symbol file only. 'inventory' is the current inventory name; evidence is the body (src/rom/*.c or asm/us/nonmatchings/rom/**.s). Lane w23g added the 18 ultralib ll.c/llcvt.c helpers (inventory __ll_mul etc.), mapped back to their former libgcc names so the recompiler sees exactly what it saw before that rename.
